subject: pharmacology
title: Oral antidiabetics and incretin therapies

steps.tx: **Metformin** (hepatic glucose output down, insulin sensitiser, weight neutral, no hypoglycaemia alone) starts every type 2 diabetic without contraindication; GI upset titrates slowly with extended release, **B12 deficiency** screens long term, and **lactic acidosis** warns in hypoxia, sepsis, renal failure (eGFR under 30 stops, contrast holds with hydration). Alcohol binges add risk; heart failure stable benefits. A1c falls 1 to 1.5 percent cheaply.
steps.say: Metformin first always unless contraindicated: titrate slow, watch B12, hold in hypoxia and contrast. No hypo alone.

steps.tx: **Sulfonylureas** (glipizide, glyburide/glibenclamide, glimepiride; pancreatic insulin release regardless of glucose causing **hypoglycaemia** with weight gain) suit thin non-ketotic adults cheaply but age and renal failure (long acting glyburide) prolong lows; **meglitinides** (repaglinide, nateglinide; meal time short, skip missed meals) flex postprandial spikes. CARDIOVASCULAR caution (UGDP tolbutamide debates) persists; beta blockers mask warning sweats. Elderly prefer short actors.
steps.say: Sulfonylureas hypo the elderly and renal: short actors, meal linked meglitinides flexibly. Weight rises.

steps.tx: **Thiazolidinediones** (**pioglitazone**: PPAR gamma, insulin sensitiser, **fluid retention with heart failure**, fractures, bladder cancer debates, hepatotoxic troglitazone withdrawn) suit insulin resistant phenotypes; **DPP4 inhibitors** (**sitagliptin** and gliptins: weight neutral, **pancreatitis** caution with bullous pemphigoid rare, renal dose cut) modestly lower without hypo; **alpha-glucosidase inhibitors** (**acarbose**: carbohydrate malabsorption with flatulence, hypoglycaemia needs glucose not sucrose) niche postprandial. Liver and bladder histories choose.
steps.say: Pioglitazone retains fluid failing hearts; gliptins stay neutral watching pancreas; acarbose ferments flatulence.

steps.tx: **GLP-1 receptor agonists** (**liraglutide, semaglutide, dulaglutide**: weight loss with nausea, **medullary thyroid cancer MEN2 caution**, pancreatitis watched, ASCVD and renal benefit proven) with **SGLT2 inhibitors** (**dapagliflozin, empagliflozin, canagliflozin**: glycosuria, **euglycaemic DKA** with Fournier gangrene rare, **heart failure and CKD benefit**) are added by comorbidity (ASCVD, HF, CKD, obesity) atop metformin; A1c targets individualise (under 7 most, looser elderly). Combination injectables (degludec-liraglutide) simplify.
steps.say: Heart failure or CKD diabetes adds SGLT2; ASCVD or obesity adds GLP-1. MEN2 forbids GLP-1; DKA euglycaemic warns SGLT2.
